existingTests.title: Formula Weights
existingTests.description: From the public homepage, open “Curious about the maths? See the formula and weights.” Confirm that the destination visibly explains the pressure formula and its weights. No account is needed.

steps.title: Open the public homepage.
Open “Curious about the maths? See the formula and weights.”
Confirm the page explains the formula and its weights.

existingTests.title: Sharing Choices
existingTests.description: On the public homepage, review the “Shared on your terms” explanation. Confirm that Hidden is the default and that the listed choices are Hidden, Lead only, and Everyone. This checks the visible explanation only, not a private setting change.

steps.title: Open the public homepage.
Review the “Shared on your terms” section.
Confirm Hidden is the default and all three sharing choices are listed.

existingTests.title: Boiler Task Flow
existingTests.description: Strictly verify creation and completion of an undated task in the seeded public demo. The formula documentation describes tasks without a due date. The 2026-10-24 run incorrectly passed after substituting Tomorrow; this version must fail if an undated task cannot be created. No authentication or real data changes.

steps.title: Open the no-sign-in demo at https://boilerhub.work/demo and note Maya’s baseline pressure.

Verify that the New task form has a way to create a task without a due date. If the available Due choices are only Today, Tomorrow, In 3 days, and In a week, fail this step. Do not silently substitute a deadline or mark the requirement passed.
Add a task titled TA QA undated task with no due date. Do not choose Tomorrow or any other deadline.
Verify TA QA undated task exists without a deadline and the pressure is greater than the recorded baseline.
Mark TA QA undated task complete.
Verify the task is marked done and the pressure drops from its value before completion.
Open the public homepage at https://boilerhub.work/.
Use the Drag to add pressure slider to set the pressure to 25.
Verify the interactive boiler shows pressure 25 with the Cool zone.
Set the same pressure slider to 55.
Verify the interactive boiler shows pressure 55 with the Working zone.
Set the same pressure slider to 80.
Verify the interactive boiler shows pressure 80 with the Hot zone.
Set the same pressure slider to 95.
Verify the interactive boiler shows pressure 95 with the Redline zone.
Open the public homepage and note the current light or dark theme.
Toggle the theme using the theme button.
Verify the visible theme changes and the theme button offers the opposite theme.
Reload the page.
Verify the chosen theme survives reload.
Toggle Sound off to Sound on, then turn sound back off.
Verify the final sound button reads Sound off and no page error is shown.
Open the homepage and follow Help from the header.
Verify the page shows The formula, Weights, Zones, and Our privacy promise.
Scroll to the bottom of the page.
Verify the removed site-wide footer and Privacy link are absent. The privacy promise remains available in Help.
Return to the homepage and use Try the demo in the main content.
Verify the no-sign-in demo opens with its demo-data notice and both Engine Room and Maya’s boiler sections.
In the fresh signed-out browser open https://boilerhub.work/boiler. Do not complete Google sign-in.
Verify personal calendar data, tasks, and account settings are not exposed; show a usable sign-in screen or redirect rather than an internal error.
Open https://boilerhub.work/teams without signing in.
Verify private teams and members are not exposed and the user is directed to sign in without an internal error.
Open https://boilerhub.work/settings/sources without signing in.
Verify source links/tokens and private data are not exposed and sign-in is required without an internal error.

tests.title: Demo task add complete and undo

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Note Maya’s current pressure and the baseline task list.
Add a manual task named TA QA lifecycle with size M and due Tomorrow.
Verify the task appears once, its title and due date are correct, and Maya’s pressure is higher than the baseline.
Mark TA QA lifecycle complete.
Verify the task is marked done, indicates steam vented, and Maya’s pressure is lower than immediately before completion.
Mark TA QA lifecycle not done again.
Verify it returns to an incomplete task and pressure rises back to the same value seen just after creation.

tests.title: Demo task size and deadline weighting

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Add a manual task named TA QA weight check with size S and due In a week.
Record the pressure and contribution of the new S task.
Change the size of TA QA weight check from S to L using that task’s size control.
Verify its selected size is L and its contribution and overall pressure increase.
Change its size back to S.
Verify the task contribution and pressure return to the values recorded with size S.

tests.title: Demo task empty input and literal text validation

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Clear New task and attempt to add an empty task.
Verify no blank task is created and the task list and pressure do not change.
Enter only spaces in New task and attempt to add it.
Verify no whitespace-only task is created and pressure does not change.
Add a task with the literal title TA QA literal & Unicode ✓, size S, due In a week.
Verify the new task title is shown as literal text with its angle brackets and Unicode intact, without interpreting the title as HTML or showing a page error.

tests.title: Demo event weight tuning and restoration

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Record Maya’s pressure and Design review contribution with its initial Heavy default weight.
In Weight for Design review choose Light.
Verify Light is selected and Design review’s contribution and overall pressure decrease.
In Weight for Design review choose Normal.
Verify the contribution and pressure are between the Light and original Heavy values.
Restore Design review to Heavy (default).
Verify the contribution and pressure return to their initial values.

tests.title: Demo status and note do not alter score

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Record Maya’s current pressure and selected status.
Change Maya’s status to Running hot.
Verify Running hot is selected and the boiler’s accessible status updates while the pressure number stays unchanged.
Change Maya’s status to Away and replace the status note with TA QA status note ✓.
Verify Away is selected, the note is visible, and pressure remains at the baseline.
Restore Heads down and the status note Shipping v2 onboarding.
Verify the original status and note are restored and pressure is still unchanged.

tests.title: Demo team zone filters and anonymous hidden members

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Select AP Bio P3 and the All filter in the Engine Room.
Verify it identifies 10 students, renders 8 visible student cards, and shows only an anonymous count for the 2 hidden students.
Filter AP Bio P3 to Redline.
Verify every shown student is Redline with pressure 90 through 100 and the number of cards matches the Redline filter count.
Select the Cool filter.
Verify it handles zero matching students with a clear empty state and no unrelated student cards.
Switch to Product Squad and choose All.
Verify the work-team heading and Lead role appear, 6 member cards are visible, and the filter counts match the visible pressure zones. Interpret card pressure as assignment preview where shown.

tests.title: Demo assignment preview and post isolation

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Select AP Bio P3. In New assignment set Title to TA QA assignment preview, Size to S and keep Due Tomorrow.
Record the preview scores and verify the Post button names 10 students including the anonymous hidden count.
Change the assignment Size from S to L.
Verify preview scores never decrease and the summary of zone transitions agrees with the visible before/after numbers. Hidden students must remain anonymous.
Post TA QA assignment preview to the seeded demo class only.

Verify the demo gives clear feedback for the post, with no sign-in requirement or server error, and any stated post/reset behavior is consistent with the displayed preview. Do not infer persistence in the demo.
Capture the final state.

tests.title: Demo forecast consistency and reload reset

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Verify the forecast has seven days; Today equals Maya’s main pressure and each day’s score matches its Cool/Working/Hot/Redline zone.
Add a task named TA QA reset check with size L and due Today.
Verify the task appears, Maya’s pressure increases, and the forecast Today score agrees with the updated main gauge.
Reload the demo.
Verify TA QA reset check is gone and the seeded tasks, pressure, and forecast are restored, consistent with Nothing you do here is saved.

tests.title: Pip customization show and hide controls

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo. Use the seeded demo only; no sign-in is needed.
Open Pip’s Dress up controls and select Top hat.
Verify Top hat is selected as the only accessory and the visible companion reflects it without changing Maya’s pressure.
Select Goggles and then Done.
Verify the customization panel closes and Goggles replaces the previous accessory.
Use Hide Pip.
Verify Pip is hidden and a discoverable control can show the companion again.
Use the visible control to show Pip again.
Verify Pip returns without losing the selected accessory or changing Maya’s pressure.

tests.title: Demo personal status synchronizes with team card

steps.title: Open https://boilerhub.work/demo and select Product Squad in the Engine Room. Use only the seeded demo; do not sign in.
In Maya’s boiler change Status note (shown to your teams) to TA QA sync verification and choose Away.
Verify Maya’s personal boiler shows the new note and Away status, and the note reports Saved.

Verify Maya’s member card in Product Squad shows TA QA sync verification and Away. Fail if it still shows Shipping v2 onboarding or Heads down; do not accept the personal boiler alone as proof of team synchronization.
Capture Maya’s team card after the status edit.
